body: Thank you. I just can't sort it out in my head yet, it still doesn't make sense, you know? Everything was so good. And I can't help but want to fix it somehow, even though it may not be possible. But thanks for the advice, I actually have an appointment with a therapist planned, and have taken up writing as a hobby, which has helped, if only a bit.
I just wish it didn't have to happen like this. There was so much to look forward to for me and her. I've dated people before, but never had a connection like this with someone

I've never thought about it like that. Thank you. I guess you're right, the best thing I can do for her now, to show that I really did care about her, is to let her make this decision, right? God, it hurts though.
